description: Erection of a part first floor rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Fire Safety Statement, 0231-003 Rev P1 received 16 February 2022; 0231-001 Rev P1 (location plan), 0231-001 Rev P1 (block plan), 0231-100 Rev P2, 0231-110 Rev P2,  0231-200 Rev P2, 0231-210 Rev P2,  0231-220 Rev P2 received 3 March 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
